walkthroughs.body_html:
The KS3 reactivity series from most to least reactive:

K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, C, Zn, Fe, H, Cu, Ag, Au

Carbon and hydrogen are non-metals included for comparison.

The top metals (K, Na, Ca) react vigorously with water. Magnesium reacts with steam. Iron reacts slowly. Gold barely reacts at all.

Higher up = more reactive.

Try: Please Stop Calling My Aunt Charlie's Zebra In Her Caravan, Sell-out Aunt.

Or make your own! Anything that helps you remember K Na Ca Mg Al C Zn Fe H Cu Ag Au.
